height="933"></picture></div><div><h2>Kite safari Egypt – kitesurfing safari and kite tours on the Red Sea</h2><p>Travel on a luxury yacht in Egypt and learn kitesurfing safari non-stop!</p><div><a href="#reservation" data-scrolling>Find out more</a></div></div></section><section><h2 data-animate><i></i> This is the 14th Kite-Safari season!</h2><div data-animate><p><b>Kite safari in Egypt</b> is seven days on a luxury 5* yacht , where you kite from dawn to dusk in ideal conditions with strong winds and flat water, discover the beauty of the Red Sea, explore coral reefs, swim with dolphins and enjoy every moment in the company of bright and wind-enthusiastic people. This travel format is ideal for learning to kite from scratch, as well as for advanced riders.</p><p>Our program is thought out to the smallest detail: from kiting and wingfoil to snorkeling, diving and wakeboarding. Evenings turn into unforgettable moments: parties, soulful gatherings and communication with new friends who become part of your kite family.</p><p>For parents with children, we hold special children's kite camps during the holidays with a nanny-animator. While you ride, your children will be under supervision.</p><p>We teach from scratch and advanced levels. If you have never ridden a kite, then a kite camp in Egypt is the perfect place to start!</p><p>Our experienced instructors will teach you everything you need, ensuring safety and maximum comfort. Your instructor will always be in touch, ready to help, and there are also rescue boats on duty to help if necessary. Training is conducted on top kites from manufacturers such as Reedin and Core.</p><h2>Why Egypt?</h2><p>Here are ideal conditions for training: a calm sea without waves, shallow lagoons and a strong wind.</p><p>We always choose the top yachts of the Red Sea, this is a real floating hotel on the water of the 5-star level. Each room is equipped with air conditioning, a bathroom, on the yacht there is access to 24/7 service, varied and delicious food on the buffet system, the highest level of comfort and a feeling of complete safety are guaranteed. You can not worry, the yacht is large enough that the rocking will pass unnoticed and you will definitely not feel seasick.</p><p>Join us to explore the beauty of the Red Sea with like-minded people, participate in movie nights, games and rich conversations. Our professional photographer will capture every moment of your adventure, and evening debriefings will help improve your riding technique.</p><p>Regardless of your experience, kitesurfing in Egypt is a chance to discover something new and unforgettable. Are you ready for adventure? <b>Then come with us on a kite safari in Egypt</b>!</p><p>This is the 14th season of Kite Safari we arrange in Egypt. So much happened in the meantime: the Egyptian revolution, the wind speed around 25 meters per second, the Cristal with lobsters, and sashimi with tuna fished personally. We have seen not only the storm but also the yacht grounding. However, the main thing is that we’ve charged with incredibly positive energy and learned to kitesurf. The newbies were learning the ropes, while more experienced kitesurfing riders were practicing skills on new tricks, demonstrating strong progress.</p><p>We possess the best conditions guaranteed for training on kitesurfing and kite-safari, as confirmed by enthusiastic feedbacks.</p><div></div></div></section><section><h2 data-animate><i></i> Kite Safari Benefits with <span>day</span></h3><ul><li>Arrival, meeting at the airport and transfer to the New Marina (center of Hurghada), yachts mooring;</li><li>Accommodation on the yacht, acquaintance, overnight accommodation on yacht at the port.</li></ul></div></div><div><div><h3>2 <span>day</span></h3><ul><li>Upon the presence of the wind: training for beginners, kiteboarding. In the evening – leisure activities, debriefing, training and developing seminars</li><li>With no wind, but with desire: wakeboarding, paddleboarding, snorkeling, scuba diving, fishing, sunbathing, walking to the nearest islands;</li><li>Regardless of the weather: photos, videos, selfies.</li></ul></div></div><div><div><h3>2–6th <span>day</span></h3><ul><li>Before the lunch: training, riding, honing the skills;</li><li>After the lunch: return to Hurghada and the final party in New Marina.</li></ul></div></div><div><div><h3>7th <span>day</span></h3><ul><li>efore the lunch: kitesurfing, training.</li><li>After the lunch: transference to Hurghada. Evening afterparty in New Marina.</li></ul></div></div><div><div><h3>8th <span>day</span></h3><ul><li>Transfer to the airport. €/person</p></article><article data-animate><h3>“Comfort” and “Suite” Cabins</h3><p>Double Room</p><p>1 600 €/person</p></article><article data-animate><h3>“Luxury” Cabins</h3><p>Luxury Double Room with Balcony</p><p>3 200 €</p></article><article data-animate><h3>“Master Suite” Cabins</h3><p>Luxury Double Room</p><p>4 000 - 5 000 €</p></article></div></div></section><div><div><div itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/FAQPage"><section data-animate itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><h3 itemprop="name">The prices include:</h3><div itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer"><ul itemprop="text"><li>Airport-yacht-airport transfer;</li><li>Accommodation on the yacht;</li><li>Three meals a day and snacks upon individual menu;</li><li>Tea, coffee, and unlimited soft drinks in the bar;</li><li>Equipment storage and kiteboard testing;</li><li>Wakeboard, paddleboard, training seminars, rescue.</li></ul></div></section><section data-animate itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><h3 itemprop="name">Separately paid:</h3><div itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer"><ul itemprop="text"><li>Flight (booking is possible);</li><li>Egypt Visa ($30 — receiving at the airport of Hurghada);</li><li>Alcohol availability in Duty free and on yacht;</li><li>Kitesurfing training: 80 euros/hour, 500 euros/a weekly course (the price includes the tinstructor service, insurance and equipment rental);</li><li>Equipment rental: 30 euros/1 hour, 60 euros/ 1 day, 300 euros/safari period;</li><li>Scuba diving with instructor: 1 diving — 35 euros;</li><li>Tips for team: 50 euro/person;</li><li>Tips for instructors — optional.</li></ul></div></section><section data-animate itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><h3 itemprop="name">Kitesurfing arrangements:</h3><div itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer"><ul itemprop="text"><li>Shorty wetsuit in 2-3 mm or wetsuit tops;</li><li>Boardshorts;</li><li>Wetsuit jackets;</li><li>Water shoes for kiteboarding;</li><li>Sunscreens;</li><li>Sunglasses;</li><li>Medicine that you may need (there’s a first aid kit on yacht);</li><li>Purchase alcohol in Duty free, if needed;</li><li>Medical insurance. Preferably, sports insurance.</li></ul></div></section></div></div></div><div><h2 data-animate><i></i> How to make a booking</h2><div><form action="/" autocomplete="on"><div><div
